answer: Because the timing is entered against the crystal challenge, the horizon audit can replay the juniper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 359 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 4358 identities would post 1088 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
